checked_arguments: The exact interior, exact-p information class is nonempty; for every g in the derivative interval, q_g=U+g*d+(L/2)*d^2 satisfies the support on the entire feasible interval, including e=0 and L=mu.

One derivative g, selected knowing the announced law before the draw, bounds every displacement; the constant-curvature witness attains the expectation at the maximizer of g*E[Z]. There is no illicit exchange of a supremum with expectation.
The robust-model expectation equals mbar(E[Z])+(L/2)*Var(Z), so a deterministic robust displacement achieves the minimax q contrast.
For arbitrary Borel eta in [0,delta], the same eta*(a)=0 and eta*(b)=delta elsewhere attains delta*P(Z!=0) simultaneously. Retention is not charged delta.
Conditioning on nonzero displacement and using positive homogeneity of the interval support function yields min(0,-Gamma+delta); the Gamma=delta and Gamma=delta=0 boundary cases are treated.

The proposition explicitly excludes full investment-formula access, finite probes, rounding, additional derivative bounds, candidate width/regret gates, computation prices and neural-exclusive advantage. The sharp witnesses need not be attainable in the implemented investment economy.
